observed_failures_and_resolutions.observation: ed25519-dalek 3.0.0-pre.1 failed against newer stable ed25519/PKCS8 KeyMalformed APIs
observed_failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Cargo downgraded the six signing packages to the published Iroh 0.95.1 lock cohort; no registry source patch was made

observed_failures_and_resolutions.observation: aws-lc-sys could not find cc after an incorrect explicit tool PATH
observed_failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Resolved native prerequisite paths from the pinned nixpkgs input and used the recorded PATH and PKG_CONFIG_PATH

observed_failures_and_resolutions.observation: Pinned Iroh uses explicit SocketAddrV4/V6 values and infallible authenticated remote_id()
observed_failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Aligned calls with those APIs and compiled under Rust 1.88

observed_failures_and_resolutions.observation: unavailable_provider_is_unknown_not_safe_retry_through_proxy failed with Err(Deadline) during worker teardown
observed_failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Do not cancel owned QUIC draining with a per-exchange timeout; await endpoint close after aborting/joining owned exchanges. The existing regression scenario then passed

observed_failures_and_resolutions.observation: Native Lattice rejected a handler wrapper that embedded JSON directly as Nickel syntax
observed_failures_and_resolutions.resolution: Import generated handler JSON through the producer Nickel contract; the real execution and restart recovery then passed
